Four divisions, 16 to 20 fights; a lost fight ends the run (Arakane's loss keeps its own text). Puzzles, Security Alert (+10% damage taken 2r), Medical (givePools 100) or Combat Protocol before each commander. Ending: ladder VI (5,000 exp, Sealed Treasury 6%). Pick 1: Skyglass Coffer x2 / Crownhold's Honor (1,000 village tokens, PROPOSAL) / Lastlight jutsu. Enemies by literal push/272 ids. Scenes borrow the Skyglass set. data.name: Crownhold
data.description:
The Lastlight Lantern burns toward a mountain the maps call empty. Crownhold, the fortress that issued the Skyglass Project's last directive, has not answered a call in a generation. Its gates stand open. Nothing guards them.

Starting the expedition spends one Lastlight Lantern. Lose any fight and the expedition ends; the Lantern is not refunded.

If you still have a reward to choose from an earlier expedition, claim it before you set out: an expedition cannot be completed while an earlier reward choice is waiting.
data.successDescription: Supreme Commander Arakane has fallen and his Command Crown lies broken. Choose your reward.

objectives.description:
The road ends at a gate cut into the mountain. No sentry calls out, no banner hangs, and snow has drifted unbroken across the parade ground. Whatever lived here left long ago.

Inside, the Experimental Armory is lit.

Rows of weapon racks hum behind glass. A brass placard by the first rack reads: "NEVER CUT THE SEAL WHILE THE CHARGE STILL HUMS." Somewhere ahead a whistle shrills, and a figure in a faded Skyglass drill uniform steps out of the light: a proctor, clipboard raised, as though you were late for a trial that began decades ago.

"Candidate. Trial number?" Its outline flickers at the seams.
Defeat Trialmaster.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The proctor dissolves into drifting light, and the drill whistle falls silent. Nothing about that was a ghost. It answered like a man reading from a memory.

Past the trial range, an ordnance store stands open. A ledger lies on the counter in a careful hand: "Coolant first, always, or the charge flashes." Behind it, the Tagwright looks up from a tray of sealed tags already glowing with heat.

"Live rounds are not for candidates," it says, and lifts the tray.
Defeat the Tagwright.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The armory narrows into a test gallery. A lance-armed construct stands bolted into a firing rig, a man's silhouette fused into its frame, the serial plate on its chest stamped 03. Beneath the number, someone scratched a reminder for the night crew: "Seal comes last."

Its capacitors whine awake. The rig releases.
Defeat the Lancer.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Beyond the gallery, a Military Command Terminal glows in the wall, and beyond that the armory's heart: a sealed door marked MASTER OF ARMS.

The terminal offers two ways through. A maintenance crawlway runs behind the live-fire racks, but its lock asks for the racks' disable sequence. Or you can request protocol access the proper way, and the duty officer, the Duelist, is already striding toward you to test your credentials with a blade.

nextObjectiveId.text: Maintenance Passage: enter the disable sequence

objectives.description: You choose: Charge, then Coolant, then Seal. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Seal, then Coolant, then Charge. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

The crawlway lock shows three switches (COOLANT, CHARGE, SEAL) and asks for the order that safely disarms the racks. A wrong order will not stop you getting through, but the armory will know you are there.

Which sequence do you enter?

The racks go quiet one by one, and the crawlway lets you out behind the sealed door before anyone has noticed you.

The Armsmaster turns from a forge wall hung with every weapon the Skyglass Project ever tested. "Clean work," he says. "Now show me whether you can fight as well as you can read." He chooses two blades without looking.
Defeat the Armsmaster.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The racks spit sparks and an alarm bell hammers through the armory. You reach the sealed door with the whole floor awake behind you.

The Armsmaster is already armed. "An intruder who trips the racks," he says, "fights tired and expected. Security Alert: all stations." The lights turn red.
Defeat the Armsmaster under Security Alert.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Duelist to claim protocol access.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Duelist kneels, its practice blade broken, and the terminal accepts your credentials. Two field protocols unlock before the Armsmaster' door.

Medical Protocol will flood you with the armory's restorative mist: you enter the fight fully recovered. Combat Protocol will instead brace you against his Sovereign Fetters, so his stuns will not hold you.

nextObjectiveId.text: Combat Protocol: steel yourself against stuns

objectives.description: Defeat the Armsmaster (Medical Protocol: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Armsmaster (Combat Protocol: stun-braced).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Beyond the armory's back stair, the air turns cold and blue. The Skyglass Research Division is a library of glass: shelves of crystal cores, each holding a faint, sleeping light.

An archivist made of that same pale light looks up from a ledger and frowns at you. "You are not on the register," it says, as if that were the stranger thing. "Understand what you are walking through. An impression repeats. An original hesitates."

It closes the ledger, and it does not hesitate.
Defeat the Archivist.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The archivist folds back into the shelves. The register it carried lists names (Skyglass researchers, engineers, officers), each with a date and the word RECONSTRUCTED.

The vat halls beyond are lit by a single tall Skyglass lamp. A containment warden stands beneath it, visor full of water, chain of vat keys at its belt. You notice the lamp throws the warden's shadow across the floor, and the warden notices you noticing.

"Replicas never cast a shadow under the Skyglass lamp," it says. "You do. Hold still for intake."
Defeat the Binder.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
In the last vat hall, something that was almost a person flickers between two outlines. Its tag reads IX. Its voice comes from both outlines at once.

"They kept trying," it says. "Every one of us carries his scar: the burn from Subject Zero's first failure. Every one of us but the copies. I am not a copy. I am not finished."

It lunges, and both of it come at you.
Defeat the Echo.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
A command terminal stands at the door of the reconstruction theatre. The plaque beside the door reads REPLICANT ZERO, and beneath it, smaller: FIRST SUCCESSFUL SUBJECT.

The terminal offers the maintenance stair behind the specimen tanks, locked until you identify the one original among three subjects. Or request protocol access, and face the theatre's last guardian: the Stonebound, the one they kept.
You choose: Subject B. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Subject C. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

Three subjects float in the specimen tanks under the Skyglass lamp. The lock asks which one is the original.

Subject A casts a shadow and bears the old burn scar.
Subject B casts no shadow and bears the old burn scar.
Subject C casts a shadow and bears no scar.

A wrong answer will still open the stair, but the theatre will be waiting for you.

The stair lets you into the theatre from behind the observation glass. On the operating floor, a man in a scientist's coat is rebuilding his own hand from light.

"Subject A," says Replicant Zero, without turning. "Correct. I was the first one they brought back, you know. My body died in that tank. I did not." He looks at you, interested. "Let us see what you are made of. I would like a copy."
Defeat Replicant Zero.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The tanks drain with a roar and the theatre floods with blue warning light. Every reconstruction rig in the room is pointed at you.

"Wrong subject," says Replicant Zero, rebuilding his own hand from light. "Containment breach protocols are already running. I was the first one they brought back. My body died in that tank. I did not." He smiles. "Neither will you leave."
Defeat Replicant Zero under Security Alert.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Stonebound to claim protocol access.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Stonebound collapses into crystal dust, and the theatre's protocols unlock.

Medical Protocol will run you through the reconstruction rig: you enter the fight fully recovered. Combat Protocol will instead overcharge your chakra, increasing the damage you deal for the opening rounds.
Defeat Replicant Zero (Medical Protocol: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat Replicant Zero (Combat Protocol: overcharged).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Above the research division, Crownhold becomes a headquarters. Maps of borders that no longer exist cover the walls of High Command. Relay lines still chatter.

A signal adjutant turns from the relay board, headset crackling. "Orders arrive by this room or they do not arrive," it says. "And only orders countersigned by the Second carry two seals. Remember that, intruder. You will not live to use it."
Defeat the Signaller.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The planning hall is set for a war council no one will attend. At the head of the table, a staff tactician corrects a campaign map with a quill of chakra ink.

"Protocol matters," it says without looking up. "The Supreme Commander's seal is always placed to the left of the Second's. Always. An order that gets that wrong was written by someone who never stood in this room." It sets down the quill and stands.
Defeat the Tactician.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The corridor to the Second's office is lined with ceremonial armour. One suit is occupied. The Honor Guard raises a tower shield bearing the High Command seal.

"Since the Silence fell over this mountain, no true order has been issued from these halls," it says. "Any order dated after the Silence is a forgery, and so are those who carry them."
Defeat the Honor Guard.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Outside the office of The Second (the Second, the only officer the Supreme Commander allowed to question him), a command terminal waits.

The service corridor to his office opens only for a properly authorised order. Or request protocol access through the front: the Runner, last courier of the Second, stands at the door with sealed dispatches crackling at its belt.

nextObjectiveId.text: Maintenance Passage: present an authorised order

objectives.description: You choose: Order A. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Order C. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

The terminal holds three orders. Only one will open the service corridor.

Order A: two seals; the Supreme Commander's seal on the right; dated before the Silence.
Order B: two seals; the Supreme Commander's seal on the left; dated before the Silence.
Order C: two seals; the Supreme Commander's seal on the left; dated after the Silence.

A forged order will still open the corridor, but it will be logged.

The service corridor delivers you into the Second's office behind a folding map table. He does not reach for a weapon at once.

"Order B," says The Second. "So you read before you fight. Good. I questioned his orders for thirty years, and I would question this one too, but I gave my word to hold this door." He straightens his coat. "So I will hold it."
Defeat The Second.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
A forged order is still an order, and High Command logs it. Every relay in the building announces your position as you step into the Second's office.

"A forgery," says The Second, and sounds almost disappointed. "I questioned his orders for thirty years. I never forged one." He signals, and the room's wards turn against you.
Defeat The Second under Security Alert.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Runner to claim protocol access.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Runner falls, and its sealed dispatches burn away into the terminal, which unlocks two protocols.

Medical Protocol will open the officers' infirmary to you: you enter the fight fully recovered. Combat Protocol will instead ward your techniques, so the Second's seals will not hold you.
Defeat The Second (Medical Protocol: fully restored).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat The Second (Combat Protocol: seal-warded).
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The last stair climbs into the summit of the mountain. The Command Sanctum is dark obsidian and ember light, and its vanguard stands across the gate in full regalia.

"State your directive," says the Vanguard. "No? Then hear the Sanctum's: when two orders disagree, the Sanctum obeys the one that protects the Command." Its gauntlets ignite.
Defeat the Vanguard.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
In the Sanctum's antechamber, a herald reads from a scroll that rewrites itself as it speaks. Lightning moves in its eyes.

"Directive..." it begins, and stops, frowning at the scroll. "A directive without a signature is not an order. It is a rumour." It rolls the scroll shut. "You are a rumour, intruder. I will correct you."
Defeat the Herald.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The night-watch corridor ends at the Supreme Commander's outer ring. The Last Watch stands in a tattered cloak, twin glaives crossed.

"The newest order countermands the old, if it is signed," it recites, as if from a manual worn thin with use. "I have kept watch for a long time, waiting for a new one. None has come." Its mask is stamped with an order no one can read.
Defeat the Last Watch.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The outer ring of the Sanctum holds Crownhold's last Military Command Terminal. Past it is the door of Supreme Commander Arakane.

The maintenance channel around the ring will open for whoever can name the directive currently in force. Or request protocol access, and face the Sealbearer, who guards the door with a sealed scroll case and a blank, unsigned command seal.

nextObjectiveId.text: Maintenance Passage: name the directive in force

objectives.description: You choose: Directive 1. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.
You choose: Directive 2. Somewhere in the walls a ward wakes and turns toward you.

Three directives are posted on the terminal. Only one is in force.

Directive 1 (older, signed by the Supreme Commander): "Hold the Sanctum doors."
Directive 2 (newer, unsigned): "Open the doors to the intruder."
Directive 3 (newest, signed by the Supreme Commander): "Seal the outer ring. Let the intruder reach me."

A wrong answer still opens the channel, but the ring will be on alert.

The channel lets you out at the foot of the throne room, exactly where Directive 3 said it would.

Supreme Commander Arakane stands at a window that looks out over the whole mountain range. "You read the orders correctly," he says. "Then you understand what this place is. Every officer you passed believes he is still serving. I gave them that. I built this command so it would outlast us." Above his brow the Command Crown turns slowly: seven blades of Skyglass hanging in the air around a gold circlet, and from every blade a thread of light running down through the floor, out to every officer you passed on the way up. You have been cutting those threads all the way up the mountain.

He turns. "It has. Now it will outlast you."
Defeat Supreme Commander Arakane. Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The ring locks down behind you as you step into the throne room. Every ward in the Sanctum turns toward you.

Supreme Commander Arakane does not hurry. "You obeyed a rumour, or an order that had already been replaced," he says. "Command does not forgive that. I built this command to outlast us all." Above his brow the Command Crown turns slowly: seven blades of Skyglass hanging in the air around a gold circlet, and from every blade a thread of light running down through the floor, out to every officer you passed on the way up. You have been cutting those threads all the way up the mountain.

He turns from the window. "It will outlast you."
Defeat Supreme Commander Arakane under Security Alert. Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat the Sealbearer to claim protocol access.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Sealbearer falls, and its blank command seal shatters on the floor. The terminal unlocks the Sanctum's last two protocols.

Medical Protocol will restore you in the Sanctum's reliquary: you enter the final fight fully recovered. Combat Protocol is the Sanctum's last field directive: for the opening rounds, nothing the Supreme Commander does can weaken you.

nextObjectiveId.text: Combat Protocol: ward yourself against debilitation

objectives.description: Defeat Supreme Commander Arakane (Medical Protocol: fully restored). Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description: Defeat Supreme Commander Arakane (Combat Protocol: debuff-warded). Defeat ends the expedition.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls and the moment is lost.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and Crownhold closes behind you.

objectives.description:
Supreme Commander Arakane falls to one knee. The Command Crown cracks through its prism core, and the floating blades drop and shatter on the stone. All through the mountain, the threads of light go slack. Then he is only light, settling over the floor of the throne room like ash.

For a moment Crownhold is silent in a new way. The relay lines stop. The lamps dim.

Then, in the signal room far below, the relay board wakes. A new order prints itself, line by line, onto the Supreme Commander's own paper. It is dated today. It bears no seal you have seen anywhere in Crownhold. It is addressed to the Ghost Ship.

The crown is broken. Something else is still giving orders.
Crownhold falls silent behind you. Whatever still gives its orders, it no longer has a crown to give them through.
Supreme Commander Arakane has defeated you. The expedition is over.
You fall, and Crownhold does not let you up. You wake outside the gate in the snow, and the Lantern has gone dark.
